title: Furie
description: A former gang leader battles human traffickers to save her kidnapped daughter.

title: Emergency Declaration
description: Korean authorities discover a terrorist suspect aboard a flight bound for the United States. With steadily decreasing fuel and international refusals to offer aid, the captain and crew take unprecedented emergency measures to save lives.

title: Bad City
description: In poverty-stricken Kaiko City, a corrupt mayoral candidate eliminates rival mafias, prompting a released ex-cop to lead a treacherous battle for justice with a special task force in the gritty underworld.

title: Code of the Assassins
description: Trained by the best, a young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. Failing to complete his mission, he becomes a fugitive hunted by the government and other rival assassins.

title: Believer
description: A low-level drug dealer joins forces with an ambitious cop to bring down a psychotic cartel kingpin.

title: Big Brother
description: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

title: God of War
description: A maverick commander and a young general join forces to battle pirates who pillage small villages in 16th-century China. The violent clash of wits and weapons will ultimately decide who rules the land.

title: God of War 2
description: Benevolent healer Seon-ui discovers a divine medicinal substance called 19; she names it Il-yeo-po, and they become friends until Dong Zhuo's soldiers forcibly seize Il-yeo-po.

title: The Villainess
description: Honed from childhood to be an elite assassin, Sook-hee embarks on a rampage of violence and revenge to finally earn her freedom and escape her past.

title: Shadow
description: To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike and two kings.

title: The Swordsman
description: A swordsman who is going blind is forced to raise his sword again to save his daughter, who has been kidnapped by a slave dealer.

title: Preman: The Silent Fury
description: After his son witnesses a brutal murder by a notorious crime boss, a deaf Indonesian gangster is thrust into the fight of his life when he takes on his dangerous former allies to protect his child.

title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
description: A vengeful crime boss forms an unlikely partnership with a detective, to catch the elusive serial killer who attacked him.

title: The Flying Swordsman
description: After two heroes are killed during an outside attempt to steal a hidden fortune, the treasure map inexplicably disappears -- until a decade later when the original eight assassins reemerge only to be challenged by a mysterious swordsman.

title: Gundala
description: Gundala, who has grown up on the streets, must choose between continuing to look out for himself or doing something about the injustice that surrounds him.
